title: [review] NON-type requests get silent drop on handler error paths (codebase convention decision)
description: P3. Handlers return positive COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_* on errors; Zephyr framework only auto-ACKs positive returns for CON (coap_server.c:274 in 4.1, :235 in 3.7) -> NON requests get NO error response. Affected: coap_dtn.c:96,122,240, coap_keys.c:267,270,430,433, helper coap_oscore.c:75,78, plus pre-existing status_get/msg_inbox_post (codebase-wide convention, not a wave regression). Over LoRa mesh NON is common. Decide the convention: explicit lichen_coap_respond/coap_oscore_respond_resource on error paths (single response for both CON and NON) vs document CON-only feedback. Implement the decision repo-wide for LCI handlers.
